subject: af-post
title: AF.POST.-----EXT.DY.
description: Diagram in PR.S(RD)II-4. The prose below identifies the structural target: 'To understand the reality of transformational journalism is to focus on how this phenomenon has come about - and what it means.' The crossing diagrams how affinity-postulation structurally meets extended-dynamics at the transformational-journalism scale: AF-POST crossed with EXT-DY. AF-POST sits at upper-center with the subject-arrow; EXT-DY at lower-center as partner-axis. POST (postulation), ALT-DEF (alternative definition) upper-right. WO-EXP-PRI (world exposure principle) upper-left. PER-DY (perceived dynamics) left, C-INFO (central information) center. VT-PLT (vibrational plateau), TR (transformation) right. LK-IMP (linkage implication) left. PROJ-DY (projection dynamics), METH (method) right. EXT-FT (extended functionalism) lower-center.
